title: Spiced Jamaican Mung Bean Curry
description: A hearty, flavorful curry made with mung beans, spiced with Jamaican seasonings and warmed with a hint of curry.

ingredients.name: Warmly spiced oil
ingredients.notes: use a mix of cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper

instructions: Heat the warmly spiced oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Jamaican curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the mung beans and cook for 1-2 minutes, until coated in the spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the mung beans are tender.
Stir in the curry and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the mung bean sprouts and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
